topic_findings.notes: Accounts disagree on the 5D Federation’s role toward Earth: Alenym calls it controlling (a581…c01); Swaruu describes higher levels as guiding/intervening through influence and selected actors (239…c05–c06; d039…c02). Another account calls the Federation an Earth controller while also assigning humans ultimate responsibility (3b62…c07). Retain speaker and source distinctions; do not normalize into one position.

topic_findings.relationship: compatible timeline and related origin accounts
topic_findings.notes: Federation founding is dated about 900,000 years ago in narration and 850,000–900,000 years ago by Swaruu, a compatible range. Both associate formation with wider conflict/Orion expansion, but remain distinct accounts and attributions.

Urmah governance is described as holographic with an experienced council organizer and royalty as a representative/symbol (3f43…c04–c05; translated counterpart 1461…c04–c05), while another account labels the political model patriarchal/matriarchal (89…c04). Claims of dominant or leading military status vary by speaker and scope; retain attribution.

topic_findings.relationship: overlapping accounts with different event emphases
topic_findings.notes: Tiamat’s aquatic nature, destruction/remnants, and flood recur across accounts. d47…c02 specifically attributes a major negative-goo arrival to the destruction; 4edf…c01–c05 centers war/flood consequences. Treat as overlapping narrative, not proof of identical causal details.
